channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Maintain routing and sensitive settings for OpenAI-compatible upstreams, then run a real probe when needed.

empty.title: No channels yet
empty.body: Create the first OpenAI Chat channel and it will appear here.

error.title: Channels could not be loaded
error.body: The service did not return the channel list. Try again shortly.

editor.createDescription: Configure an OpenAI Chat upstream that can participate in routing.
editor.editDescription: Read fields can be changed directly. Sensitive objects follow the blank-value rule.

form.autoBanHint: Allow the runtime to disable this channel after a deterministic failure.
form.modelsHint: Enter one Canonical model per line or separate them with commas.
form.groupsHint: Comma-separated group IDs. Models and groups must both be empty or both be set.
form.sensitiveHint: Leave blank to preserve the current value. Enter {} to clear it.
form.submitError: The channel could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.

validation.stringMap: Enter a JSON object whose values are all strings.
validation.url: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without credentials, a query string, or a fragment.
validation.routing: Models and groups must both be set or both be empty, and group IDs must be positive integers.
validation.sensitiveRequired: A JSON object is required when creating a channel. You can enter {}.

tokens.title: API keys
tokens.subtitle: Issue and maintain downstream API keys with quotas, expiry, model and IP allowlists, and request-window limits.

empty.title: No API keys yet
empty.body: Issue the first downstream API key and it will appear here.

error.title: API keys could not be loaded
error.body: The service did not return the key list. Try again shortly.

editor.createDescription: Create a downstream API key for a user. The full value is shown once.
editor.editDescription: Update access policy and limits without rotating the key or resetting usage.

form.ownerHint: A key cannot be moved to another user after issuance.
form.groupHint: Leave blank to use the owner's default group.
form.expiryHint: Leave blank for no expiry. Times use this device's time zone.
form.unlimitedHint: Skip the remaining-quota check for this key.
form.optionalLimit: Leave blank for no limit. Zero sets the limit to zero.
form.crossGroupHint: Allow another group when the current group has no available channel.
form.modelsHint: One Canonical model per line or comma separated. Leave blank for unrestricted access.
form.ipsHint: One IP or CIDR per line or comma separated. Leave blank for any source.
form.submitError: The key could not be saved. Check the user, group, and field values.

validation.field: Enter an in-range integer or valid field value.
validation.models: The model allowlist format or size is invalid.
validation.ips: Enter valid IP/CIDR values, up to 64 entries.
validation.date: Enter a valid date and time.

issued.title: API key issued
issued.description: The full API key for {{name}} is ready.
issued.copyFailed: Clipboard access failed. Select and copy the key manually.
issued.warning: The full key is shown only once. Save it securely before closing this window.

delete.title: Delete API key
delete.description: Deleting {{name}} immediately revokes requests using this key. This action cannot be undone.
delete.failed: Deletion failed. The key is still valid. Try again shortly.

hero.subtitle: Unified access, intelligent routing, precise billing. Collapse scattered model channels into a single observable flow.

feature.heading: Complexity stays inside the gateway
feature.subheading: AnyFlows absorbs upstream differences, failures and pricing rules, so your application only ever talks to one stable interface.

routing.title: Routing
routing.body: Selects channels by weight, priority and live health, with automatic failover and retry.

billing.title: Billing
billing.body: Group multipliers, tiered pricing and an expression engine, with auditable line items.

health.title: Health
health.body: Continuous liveness and balance probing, auto-disabling channels by rule.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.body: End-to-end SSE passthrough with per-request TTFT and throughput visibility.

pool.title: Account pool
pool.body: Typed credential management, one proxy per account, shadow accounts for rollout.

observability.title: Observability
observability.body: Per-request candidate replay recording every fallback reason and response detail.

modes.heading: One gateway, three ways in
modes.subheading: Official keys, subscription accounts, or other relays — downstream sees the same endpoint.

relay.label: API relay
relay.title: Official & compatible keys
relay.body: Aggregate official or compatible endpoints, then normalize protocols, meter by group, and resell.

sub2api.label: Subscription to API
sub2api.title: Pooled subscription quota
sub2api.body: Turn Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI OAuth quota into a standard API through an account pool.

metapi.label: Meta aggregation
metapi.title: A gateway above gateways
metapi.body: Treat existing relays as upstreams and collapse them into one entry with failover and best-route selection.

protocol.heading: Any protocol in, any protocol out
protocol.subheading: Every request normalizes to a protocol-agnostic representation first, then converts to the target — streaming included.
protocol.note: N×M conversion without hand-writing every pair.

closing.heading: Ready to collapse your model traffic?
closing.body: A single binary with the frontend embedded. One command to serve.

console.heading: One endpoint, every protocol
console.subheading: Switch protocols by changing the header, not the URL or the key. Point your existing code at AnyFlows and keep going.
